title: Rooftop Flow
blurb: A compact one-file run with wall-run assist, checkpoints and a timed finish.

verification.notes: Stands on the short start roof. Sprinting without jumping runs over the first block and off the edge into the first gap within ~1 s, then respawns at the checkpoint (normal fall, not a bug). Best time uses direct localStorage.rooftopBest access, which the hub can't isolate.
